summary: Compared all four genes in the authors’ normal-diet hypothalamus panel with the registered ob/ob-versus-WT result. Lepr and Agrp agreed in direction. Npy was lower in the figure and higher in the registered output. Ghsr had a higher ob/ob median, but its sample ranks crossed. The proposal passed the repository’s ledger-shape check. [Figure 5b](https://doi.org/10.1080/26895293.2022.2078896)
openIssues: The deposited workbook reports a genotype-by-diet interaction. Author coefficients, P values and FDR for the normal-diet genotype contrast remain unassessed. Four selected genes fall below the 30-pair concordance minimum. [Figshare deposit](https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.18666452.v1)
The cause of the Npy disagreement remains unresolved. The paper’s Lepr description also conflicts with its normal-diet panel. The labeled numeric figure matrix would help reconcile both observations.
